description: This file contains classes and functions related to filesystem-based checkpoint storage for PyTorch distributed training, including implementations for reading, writing, and managing checkpoint files, metadata, and tensor data handling.

classes.name: _StorageInfo
classes.description: Dataclass representing storage information for each checkpoint entry, including relative path, offset, length, and optional transform descriptors.

classes.name: _StoragePrefix
classes.description: Dataclass representing a prefix used in storage path naming.

classes.name: SerializationFormat
classes.description: Enum defining serialization formats: torch_save and safetensors.

classes.name: _TensorLoader
classes.description: Abstract base class for tensor loading strategies during checkpoint reading.

classes.name: _SerialCpuLoader
classes.description: Implementation of _TensorLoader that loads tensors serially on CPU.

classes.name: _OverlappingCpuLoader
classes.description: Implementation of _TensorLoader that overlaps tensor loading with computation streams for efficiency.

classes.name: _StorageWriterTransforms
classes.description: Handles transformations/extensions when saving tensor data streams.

classes.name: FileSystemBase
classes.description: Abstract base class defining filesystem operations for checkpoint storage.

classes.name: FileSystem
classes.description: Concrete implementation of FileSystemBase using Python pathlib and file IO.

classes.name: _FileSystemWriter
classes.description: Basic file IO implementation of StorageWriter, managing checkpoint files and metadata.

classes.name: _StorageReaderTransforms
classes.description: Handles transformations/extensions when loading tensor data streams.

classes.name: FileSystemReader
classes.description: Implementation of StorageReader that reads checkpoint data from filesystem.

classes.name: FileSystemWriter
classes.description: Extends _FileSystemWriter with blocking asynchronous staging capabilities for checkpoint writing.

methods.name: create_stream
methods.description: Context manager to create a file stream for reading or writing.

methods.name: concat_path
methods.description: Concatenate a suffix to a filesystem path.

methods.name: init_path
methods.description: Initialize or normalize a checkpoint path.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Create a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: validate_checkpoint_id
methods.description: Validate if a checkpoint ID/path is suitable for checkpoint storage.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Check if a file or directory exists.

methods.name: stage
methods.description: Stage a state dictionary for checkpoint saving, with optional async behavior.
